{{Quote|A rich Kalimahr. A dealer in swing dust and other air spices. And a Stargazer.|[[Tre Sana]], to [[Lanoree Brock]]|<ref name="Into the Void" />}}
'''Air spice''' was the name for a type of [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. It was [[Mining/Legends|mined]] in the [[Unidentified Kalimahr air mines|air mines]] at the north pole of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalimahr/Legends|Kalimahr]]. One variation of the substance was known as [[swing dust]].<ref name="Into the Void" />

{{Substance-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Air spice was first mentioned in ''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]'', a [[2013]] novel written by [[Tim Lebbon]].<ref name="Into the Void" />
